title: Verified TLS by default
statement: The store this component emits MUST require verified TLS for its database connection, and MUST NOT fall back to plaintext or to unverified TLS.

title: Weak transport modes are refused
statement: The store this component emits MUST refuse the sslmode values disable, allow, prefer, require and verify-ca.

title: The loopback exception is narrow
statement: The store this component emits MUST permit plaintext only to a literal loopback address and only while the explicit test setting is 1, and MUST refuse a DNS name, a Unix socket, a remote host, a host list and any other value of that setting.

title: The chain, the name and the version are checked
statement: The store this component emits MUST check the certificate chain and the server name, and MUST require TLS 1.2 or later.

title: Every read and write is scoped to its owner
statement: The storage this component emits MUST scope every read and write to the declared owner, so no query returns or changes another owner's rows.

title: Every statement is decided at generation time
statement: Every SQL statement this component emits MUST be fixed when the code is generated, with request values passed only as bound parameters, and MUST NOT assemble SQL from request input.

title: A write carries the version it read
statement: A write MUST carry the resource version it read and MUST be refused, with no change, when the row's version moved.

title: A list is a current-state view behind a stable cursor
statement: A list MUST be one ordered query over current state behind a bound cursor, and a cursor MUST NOT skip or repeat a row across pages.

title: Effects commit with their write or not at all
statement: An effect declared on a write, its notifications included, MUST commit in that write's transaction or not at all.

title: A deleted row is never read back as live
statement: Deletion MUST finalise asynchronously in one transaction, and a deleted resource MUST NOT be read back as live or be revived.

title: The schema ledger is append-only and exact
statement: The schema ledger MUST record each migration once and in order, startup MUST fail when the ledger and the generated schema differ, and the application role MUST NOT be able to alter the ledger.

title: The pool is bounded and startup fails closed
statement: The connection pool MUST honour the declared bounds, and startup MUST fail closed when a bound is invalid or the database's schema, triggers or indexes are not as generated.

title: No private value leaves the adapter
statement: No credential, row value or query parameter MUST reach a log, a metric or an error message.

title: Durations are measured with the pool wait apart
statement: The pool wait and the driver time of each operation MUST be measured as separate durations.

title: A cleanup summary is one aggregate over one snapshot with no row data
statement: The cleanup summary reader this component emits MUST return the pending deleted-resource count, the oldest original deletion time, absent exactly when the count is zero, and the statement time from one aggregate statement over one snapshot; MUST return no resource ID or payload; MUST exclude a completed owner or target and every live row; and a reopened cleanup MUST keep its original deletion time.

title: A cleanup scope is a declared field with bound parameters
statement: A target owner MUST name one nonempty target and count only rows whose retained history includes it; the scope MUST be a declared string, enum, reference or ID field, never an observation field, with both scope arguments present or absent, at most eight filters combined with AND, and each value and target a bound parameter of at most 256 bytes of valid UTF-8 without NUL, compared case-sensitively; and an unknown entity, owner or field MUST fail before any SQL work, inside the ten-second limit.

title: The active session cookie is strict
statement: The active session cookie the backend this component emits sets MUST be host-only, Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict.

title: The login cookie is lax
statement: The pending login cookie the backend this component emits sets MUST be host-only, Secure and HttpOnly, and MUST use SameSite=Lax.

title: Session records are encrypted and bound
statement: The session store this component emits MUST keep OAuth tokens only inside AES-256-GCM records that are authenticated against the SHA-256 hash of the cookie ID, and MUST NOT store the raw cookie ID.

title: The session response holds no tokens
statement: The session response the backend this component emits MUST NOT include an OAuth access token or refresh token.

title: Mutations need an exact origin and a CSRF token
statement: The backend this component emits MUST refuse a mutation that does not supply exactly one Origin header equal to the console origin and exactly one X-CSRF-Token header that matches the stored session value.

title: Browser bearer credentials are refused
statement: The backend this component emits MUST refuse any browser request that carries an Authorization header.

title: The proxy sends only server-held credentials
statement: The API proxy this component emits MUST send the server-held access token with a fixed header set to one API origin, MUST NOT forward browser cookies or any other browser header, and MUST NOT return an upstream Set-Cookie header.

title: One token renewal across instances
statement: The session store this component emits MUST permit only one token renewal for a session across all backend instances.

title: A stalled renewal reports temporary unavailability
statement: A request that waits for an active token renewal MUST return HTTP 503 with Retry-After inside a two-second deadline, MUST follow the caller's cancellation signal, and MUST keep the session cookie.

title: An uncertain renewal requires a new login
statement: The backend this component emits MUST require a new login after a lost or uncertain token renewal, and MUST NOT retry the token rotation.

title: Sign-out takes precedence over renewal
statement: A completed token renewal MUST NOT restore a session that sign-out removed.

title: The confirmation page does not sign out
statement: The sign-out confirmation page the backend this component emits MUST NOT remove the stored session and MUST NOT revoke a provider token.

title: The confirmation page referrer policy
statement: The sign-out confirmation page MUST use Referrer-Policy same-origin, and every other response MUST use Referrer-Policy no-referrer.

title: The provider sign-out request is minimal
statement: The provider sign-out request this component emits MUST send only client_id and post_logout_redirect_uri, and MUST NOT send an ID token.

title: Unsafe provider sign-out endpoints are refused
statement: The backend this component emits MUST refuse a discovered provider sign-out endpoint that is empty, that is not HTTPS, that shares the console cookie host, or that carries a query or a fragment.

title: No broad script or style permissions
statement: Every response the backend this component emits MUST carry a Content-Security-Policy header, and that policy MUST NOT permit unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval.

title: Script hashes only on the index document
statement: The backend this component emits MUST add the captured SHA-256 script hashes only to a response that serves index.html.

title: Distinct cookie hosts
statement: The backend this component emits MUST refuse to start when the identity provider, its discovered authorization endpoint, or the API shares the console cookie host, and a port, a letter case change or a final DNS dot MUST NOT bypass that check.

title: Session key file limits
statement: The session key reader this component emits MUST accept only one to three distinct 32-byte keys, inside at most 1,024 bytes, in canonical base64, and MUST NOT return key material when it refuses a file.

title: The first key encrypts, every key decrypts
statement: The session store this component emits MUST encrypt a new record with the first key in the file, and MUST decrypt a stored record with any key in that file.

title: Unsafe return paths reduce to the root route
statement: The backend this component emits MUST reduce a return path to / when that path is absolute, network-path relative, not a declared route, fragmented, percent-encoded, longer than 2,048 bytes, or holds a control character.

title: Unknown routes return 404
statement: The backend this component emits MUST return HTTP 404 for a path that is neither a declared browser route nor a captured asset.

title: A storage failure is not a sign-out
statement: A session storage failure MUST return temporary unavailability, MUST NOT report a successful sign-out, and MUST NOT delete the browser cookie.

title: The callback is consumed once
statement: The login callback this component emits MUST consume a pending login exactly once, and MUST NOT exchange the authorization code when the state value does not match.

title: A rejected identity token gets no session
statement: The login callback this component emits MUST refuse an identity token with an incorrect nonce, issuer, audience, issue time, expiry, authentication time, roles claim or access token hash, MUST NOT set a session cookie for it, and MUST revoke the received tokens.

title: The reauthentication response is fixed
statement: A rejected API session MUST return HTTP 401 with error reauth_required, login_url /auth/login and statusCode 401, and that response MUST NOT carry an upstream Location or ETag header.

title: The completion document holds no private state
statement: The protected application login completion document this component emits MUST contain only the validated local return path and fixed text, and MUST NOT contain a provider token, a callback query parameter, a session ID or an identity claim.

title: A fresh style nonce for each document
statement: When the declaration sets dynamic styles, each index.html response MUST carry a new 32-byte style nonce that matches its own document, MUST NOT reuse a cached response, and MUST forbid style attributes.

title: The runtime login has only data access
statement: The schema this component emits MUST give the runtime login only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on its session table, and the runtime MUST refuse startup when any other grant exists.

title: The runtime metadata holds no collector details
statement: The stego-runtime-config element the backend this component emits MUST carry only HTML-escaped public signal settings, and MUST NOT change the script policy.

title: Declared scopes are not changed
statement: The authorization request this component emits MUST send the declared OAuth scopes without a change.

title: An API denial keeps the session
statement: An API permission denial MUST return HTTP 403, and MUST NOT remove a valid session.

title: The pending login limit holds
statement: The session store this component emits MUST refuse a new pending login when the store already holds 1,000 pending logins, and that refusal MUST NOT leave an extra record.

title: A cross-site request gets no private response
statement: A cross-site or same-site request MUST NOT obtain the session response, the login redirect, or an API response.

title: Strict JSON only
statement: The JSON reader this component emits MUST refuse a document that has a repeated name, an invalid surrogate pair, trailing data, or excessive nesting.

title: The upstream address is compiler-owned
statement: The backend this component emits MUST refuse an upstream API address that the service environment supplies for a local application, and MUST refuse a plaintext address, a path, or a query on any upstream address.

title: A cached API response passes through
statement: The API proxy this component emits MUST return an upstream 304 response with its ETag and with no body.

title: Telemetry ingest needs a session and a CSRF token
statement: The telemetry ingest route this component emits MUST require an active session, an exact Origin, a CSRF token, and the protobuf media type, and MUST NOT forward browser telemetry to the API.

title: Telemetry admission is bounded
statement: The telemetry ingest route this component emits MUST bound the burst for one session and MUST bound the number of tracked sessions.

title: Socket admission is bounded
statement: The socket set this component emits MUST permit at most two sockets for one session and at most four sockets for one backend, and a closed backend MUST accept none.

title: A socket needs a session and an exact origin
statement: A socket upgrade MUST require an active session and exactly one Origin header equal to the console origin, and MUST refuse a browser bearer token.

title: A socket outlives the HTTP deadlines
statement: The socket handler this component emits MUST clear the connection deadlines after it takes over the connection.

title: A session end closes its sockets
statement: Sign-out, backend close, runtime stop, a storage failure, session expiry, and token expiry MUST each end that session's sockets, and MUST leave no socket lease.

title: The socket data budget holds
statement: A relayed socket MUST stop when its message count, its total bytes, or one message size passes the fixed budget, and the budget MUST count an empty message.

title: Untrusted identity headers never reach the application
statement: The local application proxy this component emits MUST NOT forward a browser cookie or a client-supplied identity header, and MUST send the server-held access token instead.

title: An application write needs an exact origin
statement: A write to a local application MUST require exactly one Origin header equal to the console origin and a same-origin fetch site.

title: An anonymous document starts login
statement: An anonymous request for a declared route MUST start login or return the sign-in page, and MUST NOT clear an existing browser cookie.

title: A captured asset needs a session
statement: A captured asset MUST require an active session, MUST use no-store, MUST NOT disclose a token, and MUST stop serving after sign-out on any backend instance.

title: Schema setup is one locked transaction
statement: Bootstrap MUST install the schema under a durable lock, MUST be safe to repeat without a schema change, and MUST roll back completely after a failure.

title: Startup refuses schema drift
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST refuse startup when the owner, the login, the table, a column, a constraint, an index, or a grant differs from the generated schema.

title: Schema input is checked
statement: Bootstrap and Verify MUST refuse a nil context, a nil connection, and an unsafe role name.

title: Startup diagnostics hold no private input
statement: Each startup stage MUST emit exactly one completion record with a fixed field set, and that record MUST NOT hold a configuration value, a secret, or a provider response.

title: A startup step keeps its cause
statement: A startup step MUST return its callback's error without a change, MUST NOT repeat the work, MUST NOT replace the caller's context, and MUST let a panic pass.

title: A failed claim keeps the session usable
statement: A renewal claim that fails to read MUST leave the session active with its original credentials, MUST NOT use the refresh token, and MUST permit a later renewal.

title: A cancelled renewal releases its claim
statement: A cancelled token renewal MUST release its stored claim.

title: Fixed same-origin transport
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST send each signal to the same-origin paths /telemetry/v1/traces, /telemetry/v1/logs and /telemetry/v1/metrics, and MUST NOT accept a collector URL, an arbitrary header or a redirect.

title: Each batch needs a session token
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST get a session CSRF token before each export batch, and MUST NOT send the batch when the session is not authenticated.

title: Generated service identity
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST label every exported record with the service identity that the compiler resolved at generation time.

title: Finite public loss categories
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST report delivery loss only as the categories queue_full, export_failed and invalid_record, and MUST NOT expose response or collector error text.

title: Bounded request and response size
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST refuse an export response larger than 16 KiB and MUST refuse an export request body larger than 256 KiB.

title: Each export has a deadline
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST stop each export at a five-second deadline and MUST give the caller a terminal result.

title: HTTPS pages only
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST refuse to start on a page that does not use HTTPS.

title: Trace IDs are checked and never zero
statement: The root trace ID generator this component emits MUST refuse a trace ID that is not 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits or is all zeros, and MUST fail instead of returning a zero ID when the platform random source gives zeros.

title: Record and attribute limits
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST refuse a log body longer than 512 characters, more than 32 metric instruments for one meter, and an attribute set with more than 16 values or a string value longer than 256 characters.

title: Callback limits equal direct limits
statement: An observable metric callback the runtime this component emits accepts MUST use the same value and attribute limits as a direct write, and the runtime MUST permit at most 32 registered callbacks for one meter and at most 32 observations for each callback collection.

title: Batch callbacks keep their selection
statement: A batch observable callback the runtime this component emits accepts MUST observe only its selected instruments from the same meter.

title: Deployment metadata controls export
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST take signal enablement and the trace sample ratio from exactly one valid runtime configuration element in the page head, and MUST disable export when that element is absent, repeated or invalid.

title: An option cannot raise the deployment ratio
statement: An explicit sample ratio option the runtime this component emits accepts MUST only reduce the deployment sample ratio, and MUST NOT enable a signal that the deployment disabled.

title: Server rendering stays inert
statement: On a server render the runtime this component emits MUST NOT create a browser exporter, a global provider or a browser timer.

title: Bounded lifecycle
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST start a flush when the page hides, MUST return one shutdown result for repeated shutdown calls, and MUST remove its page event listeners at shutdown.

title: No credential in an export body
statement: The telemetry runtime this component emits MUST NOT put the session CSRF token or another credential in an export body.

title: Strict type declarations
statement: The type declarations this component emits MUST compile under strict TypeScript, and MUST declare the lifecycle methods independent of the caller's this value.

title: Definitions are checked before any access
statement: The command runtime this component emits MUST check the application's command definitions before it reads configuration or sends a request, and MUST refuse a duplicate name, an ambiguous name prefix, a reserved name or flag, an invalid route and an invalid field.

title: Fixed definition limits
statement: The command runtime this component emits MUST hold the limits of 128 commands, 64 request fields for one command, one through four command name words, four success codes and eight named path parameters.

title: Verified HTTPS only
statement: Every API request the CLI this component emits sends MUST use HTTPS with certificate verification, and the CLI MUST refuse a plaintext destination at login.

title: No redirect and no environment proxy
statement: The HTTPS client the CLI this component emits MUST NOT follow a redirect and MUST NOT use an environment proxy setting.

title: No retry after a failure
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST NOT repeat a request after a failed, malformed or uncertain response.

title: Private configuration
statement: The configuration the CLI this component emits writes MUST have mode 0600, and the CLI MUST refuse a configuration file that permits group or other access and a configuration directory that permits writes by other users.

title: The token file stays external
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST store only an absolute reference to a token file, MUST read that file before each request, and MUST retain the file at logout.

title: Atomic configuration writes
statement: A configuration write the CLI this component emits performs MUST use an exclusive temporary file, a file sync, an atomic rename and a directory sync, and MUST NOT leave partial JSON in place of the configuration.

title: Input files must be regular
statement: Each configuration, credential and body file the CLI this component emits reads MUST be a regular bounded file, and the CLI MUST refuse a FIFO, a device and a leaf symbolic link.

title: Bounded input reaches no server
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST refuse an unknown flag, a repeated flag, an invalid field type, invalid Unicode, a duplicate JSON key and input above its limits of 256 arguments, 4,096 bytes for one argument or string field and a 65,536-byte body file, and MUST NOT send a request for refused input.

title: Exact numbers and quiet errors
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST print a response with its exact JSON numbers, and MUST report a failed request by its HTTP status without the response body.

title: Declared empty responses
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST require an empty body for a status code that the application declares empty and for HTTP 204 and 205, MUST require valid JSON for every other accepted code, and MUST refuse a declared empty code that is absent from the success codes or repeated.

title: The output file is reserved first
statement: When a command selects an output file, the CLI this component emits MUST reserve that file with exclusive creation and mode 0600 before it reads credentials or sends the request, MUST refuse an existing file, a symbolic link, a device and a parent directory that permits writes by other users, and MUST NOT send file output to stdout after a file failure.

title: Sensitive commands need a file
statement: A command the CLI this component emits marks sensitive MUST require the output file option, and MUST accept a single hyphen only as an explicit stdout selection.

title: Path parameters stay in the route
statement: A named path parameter the CLI this component emits binds MUST fill one whole route segment, and MUST NOT enter the request body or the query string.

title: Identity comes from the API
statement: The identity report the CLI this component emits MUST come from a successful API response, and MUST NOT contain a locally decoded claim, the access token or another response field.

title: Token export needs a private file
statement: Token export in the CLI this component emits MUST require the output file option, MUST refuse the raw and decoded options together, and MUST leave no output file when the identity request or the decoding fails.

title: Restricted OIDC profile
statement: The OIDC runtime this component emits MUST require the exact issuer, one matching audience, a valid expiry and issue time and an RS256, ES256 or PS256 signature, and MUST check the authorized party, the login nonce and the access-token hash when the provider supplies them.

title: Bounded native login flows
statement: Browser login in the CLI this component emits MUST use S256 PKCE, a random state and nonce and a loopback HTTP callback, MUST request only the openid scope, and MUST accept one callback answer only.

title: One owner for a token refresh
statement: A token refresh the CLI this component emits performs MUST hold a persistent lock so that concurrent processes refresh once, MUST save a pending state before the token request, and MUST require a new login after an uncertain refresh instead of using the old refresh token again.

title: Refresh keeps the identity
statement: A refreshed session the CLI this component emits MUST keep the subject, the login nonce and the original authentication time.

title: Logout removes the local session
statement: Logout in the CLI this component emits MUST attempt provider revocation, MUST remove the local configuration even when revocation fails, and MUST report the revocation error.

title: Apply validates before any write
statement: The apply command the CLI this component emits MUST check every document and resolve every target before it starts a resource write, and MUST stop before any write after a lookup failure, a malformed or ambiguous list answer or a missing required create field.

title: A dry run contacts nothing
statement: A dry run of the apply command the CLI this component emits MUST NOT read credentials, refresh a session or contact the API, and MUST report the validated status.

title: Apply reports each document honestly
statement: The apply command the CLI this component emits MUST report one status for each document, MUST report the unknown status for an uncertain write, MUST NOT repeat a write, and MUST NOT put a spec value or an API error body in its results.

title: Apply input is the JSON subset of YAML
statement: Apply input the CLI this component emits reads MUST be the JSON subset of YAML; the CLI MUST refuse an anchor, an alias, a merge key, a custom tag, a duplicate key, invalid Unicode, a NUL byte and a non-JSON number, MUST keep exact integers, and MUST refuse a symbolic link and a file that is not regular.

title: Immutable resources are never changed
statement: An immutable apply resource in the CLI this component emits MUST use exact identity lookup from required string spec fields, MUST report the unchanged status for an exact match, and MUST NOT send PATCH or DELETE for that resource.

title: Relative duration flags
statement: A relative duration flag the CLI this component emits accepts MUST send one absolute UTC RFC 3339 timestamp in its string field, MUST be exclusive with that field's own flag and with the body file, and MUST refuse a value that is not positive, an overflow and a result outside the RFC 3339 calendar.

title: Stable version report
statement: The version command the CLI this component emits MUST report the application build record and the compiler build record as JSON, MUST work without configuration, and MUST give the same answer for a repeated call.

title: Clean stdout and private telemetry
statement: The CLI this component emits MUST keep command output on stdout and diagnostics on stderr, MUST record one command completion with one of the fixed outcomes for each invocation, and MUST NOT put arguments, command names, configuration paths, credentials or raw errors in telemetry.

title: The watch opens first
statement: The runtime this component emits MUST open and confirm its watch before its first scan.

title: One action at a time
statement: The runtime MUST run one reconciliation action at a time, and MUST keep the order in which the queue holds the items.

title: A failed session restarts cleanly
statement: On queue overflow or source failure the runtime MUST cancel the session, join its workers, and open a new watch before its next recovery scan.

title: A terminal error stops the runtime
statement: The runtime MUST return an error that the terminal policy identifies, such as denied access, and MUST NOT hide it behind a cancellation from another worker.

title: Invalid options reach no source
statement: The runtime MUST check its options before it opens a source, and MUST open no source when an option is invalid.

title: Watch setup is bounded
statement: The runtime MUST bound each watch setup with the configured operation timeout, and MUST NOT scan after a failed setup.

title: Each action is bounded
statement: The runtime MUST bound each reconciliation action with the configured operation timeout, and MUST report the deadline error to the observer.

title: A retry delay holds
statement: The keyed runtime MUST keep the retry delay of a failed key, and MUST NOT let a new event for that key shorten it.

title: One action for each key
statement: With more than one worker the keyed runtime MUST run at most one action for each key at a time, and MUST let other keys run at the same time.

title: A pending result is not a failure
statement: A pending result MUST keep its key inside the queue capacity, MUST NOT count as a failed action, and MUST NOT have its recheck delay shortened by an event or by a reconnect.

title: The whole page is checked first
statement: The scanner MUST check a complete page before it starts any action, and MUST emit no item from an invalid page.

title: A slow stream cannot starve history
statement: The sweep MUST rotate its streams, so a stream that uses the whole time budget cannot stop the next pass from reading retained history.

title: The process keeps domain text private
statement: The emitted process MUST NOT write domain error text, a panic value or a goroutine dump to its output.

title: A failed callback exits with code 1
statement: The emitted process MUST exit with code 1 and exactly one fixed failure record when its callback fails, aborts or panics, and MUST let the callback's deferred cleanup finish first.

title: A cycle keeps its failure
statement: ScanCycle MUST return ErrCycleFailed for a completed cycle that had a failed action, and MUST start a new full cycle after it.

title: Telemetry carries no resource value
statement: The runtime's logs, metrics and spans MUST NOT contain resource values or callback error text.

title: An uncertain save needs a fresh load
statement: After a failed or uncertain save the state journal MUST return no usable state, and MUST NOT retry the write by itself.

title: Scans never overlap
statement: The runtime MUST NOT start a scan while another scan runs, and the resync interval MUST NOT cancel a slow scan.

title: A transient failure returns with the next scan
statement: A transient action failure MUST be retried through the next scan of retained state.

title: Cancellation prevents the checkpoint save
statement: A canceled parent context MUST prevent the checkpoint save.

title: The commit reserve is protected
statement: RunObservation MUST reserve its commit time inside the parent deadline, MUST NOT let the work callback use that reserve, and MUST NOT accept a success that the work callback returns after its deadline.

title: A state record binds its key and its version
statement: A sealed state record MUST fail to open with another instance, entity, resource, scope or version, MUST fail to open after any single-bit change, and MUST stay redacted in formatting and in implicit JSON export.

title: The keyed queue starts paused
statement: The keyed runtime MUST start paused, MUST wait for a complete baseline, and MUST keep its queued work across a baseline reset.

title: An invalid key consumes no capacity
statement: The keyed runtime MUST refuse an empty key, an oversized key and a key that is not valid UTF-8 with ErrKey, and MUST keep no entry for it.

title: A due retry precedes new work
statement: The keyed runtime MUST take a due retry before a newer key.

title: A probe starts no application work
statement: A probe command MUST NOT start the application callback, MUST accept only the two probe values, and MUST accept only a literal loopback address with an explicit nonzero port.

title: The client keeps one verified origin and path prefix
statement: The SDK client this component emits MUST use verified TLS 1.3 to one origin and one path prefix, MUST refuse a plaintext base URL, and MUST refuse a server whose certificate it cannot verify.

title: The client follows no redirect and no proxy and does not retry
statement: The SDK client MUST NOT follow a redirect, MUST NOT use the environment proxy settings, and MUST NOT retry a request.

title: The public API hides its transport
statement: The SDK client MUST require a bearer token of a checked character set and MUST NOT expose a raw HTTP client constructor or a request editor.

title: A failed call keeps its status and hides its secrets
statement: An HTTP error response MUST keep its status and its typed body, and a transport or decoding failure MUST return an error that holds no bearer token and no response body.

title: A caller deadline wins
statement: The SDK client MUST use a five-second deadline by default, MUST accept only a configured deadline from one through thirty seconds, and MUST honour a shorter caller deadline.

title: The client bounds its active calls
statement: The SDK client MUST permit at most sixteen active calls and MUST refuse the next call instead of queueing it.

title: Close bounds its wait and ends the client
statement: Close MUST cancel the transport calls, MUST wait at most one second for active calls, and MUST make every later call fail.

title: A nullable property keeps its three states
statement: A nullable model property this component emits MUST keep an omitted member, an explicit JSON null and a value apart in both directions, including a zero value such as an empty string, false or zero.

title: The service needs verified TLS 1.3
statement: The gRPC runtime this component emits MUST require a certificate and a private key and MUST refuse a connection below TLS 1.3.

title: Every method uses the verifier
statement: Every registered unary and stream method MUST pass through the JWT verifier, and a request that carries more than one bearer value MUST fail.

title: Messages, headers, streams and calls are bounded
statement: The runtime MUST bound the request message size, the response message size, the header list size, the streams per connection, the connections and the active unary calls, and MUST give each unary call a ten-second deadline.

title: A stream ends at token expiry or its lifetime
statement: A server stream MUST stop at the verified token's expiry or at its maximum lifetime, and a blocked stream input or output operation MUST close its TCP connection.

title: An unknown failure stays private
statement: An unknown application error or a handler panic MUST become a fixed internal status error, and the runtime MUST NOT enable gRPC reflection.

title: Registered cleanup runs once, in reverse order
statement: Cleanup callbacks the registration factory handed to the runtime MUST run once in reverse registration order when startup fails, when the runtime stops or when it is closed, and a callback panic MUST be reported without its contents.

title: The outbound client needs trusted TLS and a private token
statement: The gRPC client this component emits MUST require TLS 1.3, MUST check the server identity, MUST read its bearer token from a private regular file for each call, and MUST NOT let a call option raise its message, call or stream limits.

title: A terminal stream result completes its observation first
statement: A terminal Header or RecvMsg result on an emitted client stream MUST complete the stream's telemetry exactly once before it returns.

title: Client telemetry names the method and keeps the whole stream
statement: An emitted client MUST take its telemetry method name from the compiled contract and MUST record the complete stream lifetime, including an abandoned or remotely completed stream.

title: Stream header requirements are checked before the stream is touched
statement: The stream header helper this component emits MUST refuse an invalid, empty, duplicated, over-long or non-ASCII header requirement with its contract error, and MUST NOT read the stream's headers or messages in that case.

title: Timestamp conversion is checked and keeps presence
statement: The timestamp conversion this component emits MUST refuse an instant outside the protobuf range with no output and a fixed error that holds no supplied value, MUST keep a nil optional input absent and a present zero time present, MUST own each result, and MUST drop the monotonic clock and the local zone.

title: A response mapping keeps the contract and owns its output
statement: A generated response mapping MUST keep the declared wire contract, including field presence for a present empty value, MUST own its output storage, and MUST return no partial message when a value fails its check.

title: A request without an authority is refused
statement: The emitted runtime MUST refuse an HTTP/2 request that carries no authority header, and MUST answer it with status 400 and the internal gRPC status.

title: A prepared registrar runs its callback in one place
statement: A registrar prepared with a request callback MUST run that callback after verification and admission, once after protobuf decoding for a unary call and once before a stream handler, within the normal request deadline.

title: A prepared response mapping uses only the supplied values
statement: A response mapping that declares inputs MUST take those values from its application argument instead of the stored model, MUST keep their presence, MUST own its results, and MUST return no partial message for an invalid value.

title: Stream headers are checked without consuming the stream
statement: The stream header helper this component emits MUST check the required initial headers without consuming a stream event, MUST keep the terminal RPC result when no headers arrive, and a header error MUST NOT carry a remote metadata value.

title: A TLS probe pins the leaf and carries no credential
statement: The TLS probe this component emits MUST require TLS 1.3, a trusted chain, a matching name and a matching SHA-256 digest of the peer's leaf certificate, and MUST send no credential or caller metadata.

title: A process needs no API repository and no database
statement: The process executable this component emits MUST NOT construct the primary API repository and MUST NOT require a database connection to start.

title: Initialization is bounded and traced
statement: The process MUST call the domain Open function with an initialization context that has a ten-second deadline and carries the process telemetry runtime, and MUST run registration once before the listener opens.

title: Shutdown and flush are bounded
statement: After cancellation or entry into cleanup the process MUST permit at most twenty seconds for shutdown and flush, and a blocked domain callback MUST NOT keep the executable alive past that limit.

title: A failing callback stays private and still fails the process
statement: The process MUST catch a callback panic and a goroutine exit without printing private values, MUST emit a fixed failure event, MUST keep the remaining cleanup and the telemetry flush, and MUST exit non-zero.

title: The health monitor binds only a loopback address
statement: The process health monitor MUST accept only a literal loopback IP address with a canonical port from 1 through 65535, and MUST NOT expose metrics or application data.

title: A probe is bounded and does no domain work
statement: A probe command MUST finish within one second, MUST NOT call the domain Open function, MUST NOT use a proxy or follow a redirect, MUST require status 200 with the exact body ok and a newline, MUST accept only GET, and MUST fail on an unknown argument.

title: Liveness and readiness follow the process state
statement: Liveness MUST answer during initialization, readiness MUST answer only after registration finished and the TLS listener is bound, and both MUST fail once shutdown started.

title: A monitor that cannot bind fails the process first
statement: When the health monitor cannot bind its address, the process MUST fail and MUST NOT call the domain Open function.

title: Readiness starts unavailable
statement: The readiness endpoint this component emits MUST answer 503 until the monitor completes a successful sample.

title: Liveness ignores dependencies
statement: The liveness endpoint this component emits MUST NOT query a database or an external provider.

title: A probe reads the saved sample
statement: A probe request to the endpoints this component emits MUST read the saved sample only, and MUST NOT start a dependency call.

title: The probe response is safe
statement: A response from the endpoints this component emits MUST set Cache-Control to no-store, and MUST NOT contain a dependency error or a credential.

title: A sample cycle is bounded
statement: The monitor this component emits MUST cancel a sample cycle after a shared deadline of 500 milliseconds.

title: Cancellation clears readiness
statement: The readiness endpoint this component emits MUST answer 503 as soon as the service context is canceled.

title: One run for one monitor
statement: The monitor this component emits MUST refuse a second Run call.

title: Readiness expires
statement: The readiness endpoint this component emits MUST answer 503 when the last successful cycle started more than two seconds before.

title: No overlapping checks
statement: The monitor this component emits MUST NOT start another check callback while one callback is active.

title: Only the probe routes are public
statement: The probe routes this component emits MUST stay outside application authentication, and MUST NOT change the authentication of another route.

title: Bounded construction
statement: The monitor this component emits MUST refuse a nil context, a nil check, more than 16 checks and a nil database.

title: A fixed method policy
statement: The endpoints this component emits MUST answer a HEAD request with no body, and MUST refuse every other method with 405 and an Allow header.

title: The client keeps one verified origin
statement: The HTTPS client this component emits MUST send every request to the configured HTTPS origin with verified TLS 1.3, and MUST refuse a request that changes the origin, the scheme or the path prefix.

title: The client refuses a redirect and bounds both bodies
statement: The HTTPS client MUST NOT follow a redirect, MUST refuse a request body above its request limit, and MUST refuse a response body above its response limit.

title: The client bounds its active calls and does not queue
statement: The HTTPS client MUST permit at most sixteen active requests, MUST refuse the next call instead of queueing it, and MUST NOT retry a request.

title: Close ends the client
statement: The HTTPS client MUST cancel its active requests and streams when the application closes it, and MUST refuse every later request.

title: A stream is bounded in frame size, total size and time
statement: The stream this component emits MUST deliver its frames in order, MUST stop at its frame limit, its total limit and its stream deadline, and MUST refuse a call that supplies no callback.

title: A credential file must be private
statement: The client MUST read a credential file only when it is a bounded regular file with mode 0400, 0600, 0440 or 0640, and MUST refuse execute access, group-write access and other access.

title: A certificate pin narrows trust but does not replace it
statement: When the application supplies a peer certificate pin, the client MUST still check the CA chain and the server name, MUST copy the pin when it starts, and MUST refuse an all-zero pin.

title: A cancelled response returns no data
statement: When the caller's context ends while the client reads a response, the client MUST return no response data, MUST close the response body, and MUST release its request permit.

title: An endpoint verifies before it decodes
statement: The endpoint this component emits MUST verify the bearer token before it decodes the request body, and MUST NOT call domain code for an unauthenticated or undecodable request.

title: No response is cached
statement: Every response the endpoint writes MUST carry the Cache-Control header value no-store.

title: A JSON body is one strict object
statement: The JSON body reader this component emits MUST accept one JSON object within its byte limit, and MUST refuse an unknown member, a duplicate member, a case alias, a trailing value, invalid UTF-8, an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate and nesting above its depth limit.

title: A required member must be present, but may be a zero value
statement: A request member tagged stego:"required" MUST be present and not null, and the reader MUST still accept an empty string, a zero number, false and an empty array as values.

title: An empty status carries no body
statement: An endpoint declared with status 204 or 205 MUST write no body and no content type, and endpoint construction MUST fail when its response type can carry a body.

title: A dynamic reply fails closed on a wrong status and body pair
statement: A reply endpoint MUST require a value for a response body, MUST refuse a 204 or 205 reply that carries one, and MUST fail before it writes a success status.

title: A preparation callback runs once, in one place
statement: A preparation callback MUST run once after token verification and successful decoding and before the domain call, MUST use the request deadline, and its error MUST NOT become an authentication failure.

title: A cancelled request stops its body read
statement: The endpoint MUST stop a blocked request-body read when the request context ends, and MUST answer 503.

title: Private error text stays private
statement: The endpoint MUST pass a domain error to the application's error handler and MUST NOT put the error text in the response itself.

title: Ordering accepts only declared public fields
statement: The order parser this component emits MUST accept only a declared public field name with an asc or desc direction, and MUST refuse an unknown name, a duplicate name, extra words and over-long input.

title: Projection keeps the envelope and the exact values
statement: The list projector this component emits MUST keep the list envelope, the item order, the exact JSON numbers, the explicit nulls and the absent optional members, and MUST return only the selected declared fields.

title: A selector is checked whether or not the result holds rows
statement: The projector MUST refuse an unknown path, a duplicate path, an empty term and an invalid wildcard with its request error, and that check MUST NOT depend on the response content.

title: Projection bounds every response value
statement: The projector MUST refuse a response above its encoded size, depth, member, element or value limits, and MUST refuse a malformed list, returning its projection error.

title: A projector copies its schema and is safe to share
statement: The projector MUST copy its field schema when it is built, so a later change to the caller's schema cannot widen a selection, and one projector MUST be safe for concurrent calls.

title: An unselected list keeps the normal response path
statement: When the caller supplies no field selection, the optional projector MUST return the original response value without encoding it or projecting it.

title: A managed application is supervised and closed once
statement: When the application handler supplies both Run and Close, the runtime this component emits MUST supervise its task and MUST call its cleanup at most once.

title: A response mapping does no input or output and hides its values
statement: A generated response mapping function MUST perform no input or output, MUST return no response and the fixed conversion error when a value fails its check, and MUST NOT put the supplied value in that error.

title: A response owns its storage
statement: A generated response mapping MUST copy each pointer, list and map value into response-owned storage, so a later change to the source or to a sibling response cannot change the result.

title: A credential read follows a link by default
statement: The client MUST accept a leaf symbolic link to a credential file by default, because a Kubernetes projected Secret mount is a symbolic link, and MUST refuse one when the rendering component asks it to refuse links.

title: The server serves TLS 1.3 from private local key files or does not start
statement: The HTTP server this component emits MUST serve TLS 1.3 from a certificate and key read once from private, bounded, local files, and MUST refuse to start when TLS is required and a TLS setting is missing or ambiguous.

title: A TLS connection keeps the plaintext limits
statement: The HTTP server this component emits MUST apply its request limits and its shutdown drain to a TLS connection exactly as to a plaintext one.

title: A server diagnostic is private, non-blocking and bounded
statement: A diagnostic the HTTP server this component emits writes MUST NOT carry a panic value, a stack trace, a source path or a peer address, MUST NOT make request admission wait, and its logger MUST close within one second after shutdown.

title: Claims stay hidden until every check passes
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST NOT give a token claim to the application before the signature, the issuer, the audience, the subject, the issue time and the expiry all pass.

title: RS256 only, and unsupported headers refused
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST accept the RS256 algorithm only, and MUST refuse a token that has a typ other than JWT or a crit, jku, jwk or x5u header.

title: The RSA key size is bounded
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse an RSA public key that has fewer than 2048 bits, more than 8192 bits, or an exponent other than 65537.

title: Explicit trust settings at startup
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse to start when the issuer is not an HTTPS URL or when the audience is empty.

title: Oversize and ambiguous tokens are refused
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse a token that is larger than 16 KiB, or that has a duplicate member or more than 32 levels of nesting in its header or payload.

title: Exactly one Bearer credential
statement: The middleware this component emits MUST refuse a request whose configured header does not hold exactly one Bearer credential.

title: The JWT denial response is safe
statement: An unauthorized response from the middleware this component emits MUST NOT contain the token, and MUST set Cache-Control to no-store with a WWW-Authenticate header.

title: Roles come from one configured claim
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST read roles only from the configured claim path, and MUST NOT use another claim as a fallback.

title: A malformed role claim fails authentication
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST fail authentication when the configured role claim is not an array of at most 128 clean strings of at most 256 bytes.

title: The verified issuer and subject pair
statement: The identity this component emits MUST hold the verified issuer in Identity.Issuer and the verified subject in Identity.UserID.

title: One exact key, and no fallback key
statement: The key set this component emits MUST select the key whose key ID matches the token exactly, and MUST NOT fall back to another key in the document.

title: Key document bounds
statement: The key set this component emits MUST refuse a key document that is larger than 64 KiB, that holds a repeated key ID, or that holds more than 32 keys.

title: Verified TLS for a remote key source
statement: The key source this component emits MUST load a remote key document only over verified TLS 1.2 or later from an HTTPS URL, and MUST NOT follow a redirect.

title: No proxy for key retrieval
statement: The key source this component emits MUST NOT send a key request through an HTTP proxy.

title: One bounded request for each refresh
statement: The key source this component emits MUST make one request for each refresh and MUST keep at least thirty seconds between attempts.

title: A bounded outage window
statement: The key source this component emits MUST deny every token fifteen minutes after the last successful key load, until a later load succeeds.

title: A removed key stops at once
statement: The key source this component emits MUST deny a token whose key the replacement key document does not hold.

title: Stop closes the verifier
statement: After Stop, the key source this component emits MUST deny every later verification, and a repeat Stop MUST be safe.

title: Key errors hold no provider detail
statement: An error from the key source this component emits MUST NOT contain the source address or the provider response body.

title: Key telemetry holds no private data
statement: A telemetry record from the key source this component emits MUST NOT contain a token, a key ID, a key document, a file path, a source URL or provider error text.

title: A cache hit emits no refresh work
statement: The key source this component emits MUST NOT emit refresh telemetry for a cache hit, a cooldown rejection or a stopped verifier.

title: Grants match every authority dimension
statement: The grant policy this component emits MUST permit an operation only when the issuer, the subject, the resource, the operation and the target all match exactly, and it MUST NOT use a wildcard, a prefix, a role or an administrator fallback.

title: An empty policy denies everything
statement: A nil grant policy and a zero grant policy that this component emits MUST deny every operation.

title: Invalid token Unicode is refused
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST refuse a token whose payload holds an unpaired Unicode surrogate escape, and it MUST NOT expose that value as an identity field.

title: Stop cancels an active retrieval
statement: Stop on the key source this component emits MUST cancel a key retrieval that is already running, and MUST deny the request that started it.

title: An empty key source fails closed
statement: A zero value of the key source this component emits MUST deny every token, and Stop on that value MUST be safe.

title: Grant documents are strict
statement: The grant document reader this component emits MUST refuse an unknown, repeated, absent, miscased, null or coerced member, invalid Unicode, a trailing document and more than 262,144 bytes.

title: Grant bounds and uniqueness
statement: The grant policy this component emits MUST refuse a repeated grant, more than 1,024 grants, an empty issuer or subject, an oversize target, and a resource or operation name outside its character set.

title: An empty or literal wildcard target is exact
statement: The grant policy this component emits MUST treat an empty target and a literal asterisk target as exact values, and MUST NOT let either match another target.

title: The verifier is safe for concurrent use
statement: The verifier this component emits MUST give the same verified identity to concurrent callers.

title: Every replica must acknowledge
statement: The publisher this component emits MUST require the acknowledgement of all in-sync replicas for each record.

title: The message identity travels with the record
statement: The publisher MUST send the stable message ID and the message kind as record headers, and MUST use the resource key as the partition key.

title: A projected secret file is readable
statement: The publisher MUST accept a private file that a projected link supplies, and MUST check that the file identity and the mode do not change between the check and the open descriptor.

title: Verified TLS for every broker
statement: The publisher MUST verify the broker certificate against the supplied trust and the broker host name, and MUST NOT connect without TLS.

title: SCRAM runs over TLS only
statement: The publisher MUST authenticate with mutual TLS or with SCRAM-SHA-512 over TLS, and MUST refuse wrong credentials.

title: An error holds no credential
statement: An authentication error MUST NOT contain the password or other credential text.

title: SCRAM work is bounded
statement: The publisher MUST check the SCRAM challenge size and its iteration count before it derives a key, and MUST accept only 4,096 to 100,000 iterations.

title: An uncertain result closes its producer
statement: The publisher MUST close the producer whose result is uncertain at the attempt deadline, MUST return an error, and MUST use a new client for a later call.

title: Only private secret modes are accepted
statement: The publisher MUST accept the secret file modes 0400, 0600, 0440 and 0640 only, and MUST refuse an execute bit, group write access and other access.

title: Configuration checks come before the network
statement: The publisher MUST refuse an invalid broker list, an unsupported authentication value, an invalid topic, a missing key file and an invalid trust file before it connects.

title: A record payload is bounded JSON
statement: The publisher MUST refuse a record whose payload is empty, is not valid UTF-8, is not valid JSON or is over its byte limit.

title: A broker denial is not a success
statement: The publisher MUST return an error when the broker denies the record, and MUST NOT report the publication as complete.

title: The runtime needs the queue schema
statement: The emitted runtime MUST check the outbox queue schema before it connects to a broker.

title: The runtime delivers retained work after a restart
statement: The emitted runtime MUST deliver a message that the queue retained before the process restarted, MUST refuse to run after Close, and MUST refuse a second concurrent run.

title: A closed publisher refuses more work
statement: A closed publisher MUST refuse a later publish with ErrClosed, and a close during active calls MUST NOT break them.

title: Publication follows the commit
statement: The emitted runtime MUST NOT publish a message before its transaction commits, and MUST remove the message from the queue after the broker acknowledges it.

title: Token proof uses the shared verifier
statement: The provider this component emits MUST verify a service-account token with the shared JWT verifier, and MUST use signing keys from the configured issuer only.

title: The token claims must match the saved policy exactly
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a service-account token whose subject, client, audience set, role arrays or signed lifetime differs from the saved policy.

title: No extra or duplicate audience
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a service-account token that holds an extra audience, a duplicate audience or a non-string audience.

title: The grant response must hold an access token only
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client-credentials response that holds a refresh token, an ID token, or a token type other than Bearer.

title: An unsafe client gets no credential
statement: The provider this component emits MUST NOT read or release a client secret for a public client, a disabled client, or a client whose dedicated subject is absent.

title: Ownership is checked again before the grant
statement: The provider this component emits MUST stop the operation with ErrOwnership when the ownership attributes change during that operation.

title: Browser callbacks are exact HTTPS URLs
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a browser callback that is not an exact HTTPS URL with a path, and MUST refuse a wildcard, a query, a fragment, credentials, a traversal, an encoded alias, a loopback host or an ambiguous authority.

title: The logout callback shares the login origin
statement: The provider this component emits MUST require the login callback and the logout callback on the same origin.

title: A confidential browser client with PKCE S256
statement: The browser client the provider this component emits configures MUST be confidential and MUST use the authorization code flow with PKCE S256.

title: Unsafe browser drift is refused
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a browser client that turns on the implicit flow, password grants, service accounts, full scope, a wildcard redirect, a wildcard web origin, plain PKCE or an unknown security attribute.

title: Verified transport to the provider
statement: The provider this component emits MUST use HTTPS to the Keycloak server and MUST NOT follow a redirect.

title: Credentials print as redacted text
statement: A credential, a client pointer and a migration plan that this component emits MUST print as redacted text for every Go formatting verb.

title: A creation is confirmed by a read of the saved ID
statement: The provider this component emits MUST confirm a client creation with a read of the saved provider ID, MUST NOT follow the Location header, and MUST NOT repeat the creation request.

title: A conflict is not adoption
statement: The provider this component emits MUST return ErrConflict for a creation conflict, and MUST NOT adopt or replace the existing client.

title: A new client starts disabled
statement: A client the provider this component emits creates MUST have login disabled, no secret in the request, and every browser, password and authorization flow off.

title: Ownership binding refuses a foreign record
statement: A binding helper this component emits MUST refuse a nil client, a foreign client name, mixed legacy and current attributes, partial ownership keys and a foreign reserved key, and it MUST return ErrOwnership.

title: A candidate search cannot expand
statement: The client search this component emits MUST refuse an empty fragment and a SQL pattern character before any request, and a failed search MUST NOT fall back to a full scan.

title: A managed identity comes from trusted values
statement: An identity helper this component emits MUST compose the client name and the ownership attributes from the declared ids only, and MUST give every ownership key the reserved stego.owner. prefix.

title: A legacy audience name stays caller-known
statement: An audience binding helper this component emits MUST accept a caller-known stored client name for the legacy form only, and MUST require the generated name for current ownership.

title: A failed search is not repeated or widened
statement: The client search this component emits MUST make one request for one page, and MUST NOT repeat or widen a denied, null, oversize or ambiguous result.

title: An ambiguous provider response is refused
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a provider response that holds a different ID, a duplicate member, invalid Unicode, trailing data or a repeated record, and it MUST report ErrResponse.

title: An invalid administrator grant cannot authorize a request
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse an administrator grant that has no Bearer type or a lifetime outside 1 to 3,600 seconds, and MUST NOT send an API request with it.

title: Identifiers and pages are checked before the network
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client identifier outside its character set and a page outside its bounds before it makes any request, and every request MUST stay inside the selected realm.

title: A disable needs an explicit state
statement: The provider this component emits MUST refuse a client record that states no enabled value, and MUST NOT treat that record as disabled.

title: Credential rotation invalidates the token cache
statement: The provider this component emits MUST read its private credential file again for each grant, MUST clear a cached token after an unauthorized response, and MUST NOT replay that request.

title: Close releases every caller
statement: The provider this component emits MUST release a canceled or expired caller that waits for the token gate, and MUST refuse work after Close with ErrClosed.

title: A provider span holds no request data
statement: A span the provider this component emits MUST keep the caller trace, MUST NOT send baggage or a trace state to the provider, and MUST NOT contain a client name, a provider ID, the server URL or a credential.

title: Closure is saved as intent before any provider call
statement: The lifecycle this component emits MUST save an irreversible closure intent with the known provider ID when closure is prepared, and MUST make no provider call until that save is acknowledged.

title: Deletion needs confirmed current ownership at the saved ID
statement: The lifecycle this component emits MUST delete a client only after it confirms current ownership at the saved provider ID, MUST refuse a foreign, mixed or unconfirmed owner, and MUST NOT delete when the save of the recovered binding is rejected or its acknowledgement is lost.

title: Strict field validation on writes
statement: The write requests this component emits MUST carry `fieldValidation=Strict` and MUST keep the caller's other query options.

title: Malformed write query fails before I/O
statement: The client this component emits MUST reject a malformed write path or query before it sends a request.

title: No retry of a resource write
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT retry a resource write after a conflict or a rejection.

title: Token read for each request
statement: The client this component emits MUST read its token file again for each request and for each watch reconnect.

title: Private credential file required
statement: The client this component emits MUST refuse a token or credential file that permits execution, group write access, or any access for other users.

title: Ownership labels before an update or a delete
statement: The client this component emits MUST find every selected ownership label on an existing resource before it updates or deletes that resource.

title: UID and version preconditions
statement: The patch and delete requests this component emits MUST carry the observed UID and resource version as preconditions.

title: No write for a converged resource
statement: The create-or-update operation this component emits MUST NOT write a resource that already contains the desired state.

title: Deletion reports absence only
statement: The deletion helper this component emits MUST report completion only after the resource is absent.

title: Caller input preserved
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT change the desired object or the change object that the caller supplies.

title: Exact numbers and one JSON object
statement: The decoder this component emits MUST keep JSON numbers as their exact text and MUST reject a response that is not exactly one JSON object.

title: Failure data limited to status metadata
statement: The errors this component emits MUST expose only the request method, the HTTP status, and the retry delay.

title: Bounded retry delay
statement: The client this component emits MUST limit a parsed `Retry-After` delay to one hour.

title: Reset before a list, replace after validation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST send `RESET` before each new list and MUST send `REPLACE` only after every page passes validation.

title: Watch uses the snapshot cursor
statement: The watch request this component emits MUST use the snapshot resource version and MUST NOT carry the list's paging options.

title: Expired history forces a new list
statement: The observer this component emits MUST start a new list after the API server reports expired watch history.

title: Access denial stops observation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST stop observation when the API server denies its list or watch request.

title: Bounded snapshot
statement: The observer this component emits MUST stop a snapshot that exceeds 10,000 objects, 64 MiB of object data, or 1,000 pages.

title: Consumer error and invalid path stop observation
statement: The observer this component emits MUST return the consumer callback's error and MUST reject a collection path that is not a canonical Kubernetes API path without a query.

title: Discovery fails closed and never caches
statement: The discovery check this component emits MUST reject invalid resource requirements before any request, MUST read discovery again for each call, and MUST fail when a required resource, kind, namespace scope, or verb is missing or duplicated.

title: Deployment availability requirements
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST require the observed generation, the exact total, updated, ready and available replica counts, no unavailable replica, and an `Available=True` condition.

title: Paused or deleting Deployment is not available
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST report a paused or deleting Deployment as not available.

title: Malformed observation is an error
statement: The availability check this component emits MUST return `ErrResourceObservation` for a foreign owner, a missing identity, or a malformed count or condition.

title: Observation helpers make no network call
statement: The availability, Route admission, and TLS Secret checks this component emits MUST NOT make a network call.

title: Route requires the selected passthrough backend
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST require one TLS passthrough backend with the selected host, Service, target port, and router.

title: Route check rejects weaker exposure
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST reject path routing, a wildcard policy, an alternate backend, a disabled backend, and TLS termination at the router.

title: Missing admission is pending
statement: The Route check this component emits MUST report missing or absent router admission as pending without an error.

title: Probe after admission, then a new read
statement: The Route helper this component emits MUST call the application probe only after admission passes, and MUST read the Route again after the probe.

title: Unchanged Route identity around the probe
statement: The Route helper this component emits MUST report failure when the Route UID or resource version changes around the probe.

title: Stored name and namespace must match
statement: The create-or-update operation this component emits MUST reject a stored resource whose name or declared namespace differs from the desired object.

title: Explicit trust only
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST use only the caller's explicit trust pool and MUST NOT accept a trust anchor from the Secret.

title: Certificate field holds only certificates
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST reject a private key block, extra text, or a malformed block prefix in the certificate field.

title: One complete private-key block
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST require exactly one complete private-key PEM block in `tls.key`.

title: TLS failures carry no detail and respect data limits
statement: The TLS Secret verifier this component emits MUST return `ErrResourceObservation` without certificate, key, hostname, or parser detail, and MUST permit at most 512 KiB of certificate data, 64 KiB of private key data, and 16 certificates.

title: Client certificate purpose
statement: The client certificate verifier this component emits MUST refuse a certificate that permits only server use.

title: Trust bundle parser
statement: The trust parser this component emits MUST reject private material, PEM headers, and text outside the certificate blocks, and MUST return a pool that does not change when the caller changes the input bytes.

title: Secret set digest covers data, not metadata
statement: The Secret set digest this component emits MUST change with the Secret names and data, and MUST NOT change with resource metadata alone.

title: Secret set validated before any write
statement: The Secret set operation this component emits MUST validate the complete desired set before it writes to Kubernetes.

title: Secret set requires exactly the stored data
statement: The Secret set operation this component emits MUST require each stored Secret to contain exactly the desired data, and MUST read every Secret again and check its UID, resource version, and data before it returns the digest.

title: Secret and credential errors carry no data
statement: The Secret and credential errors this component emits MUST NOT contain Secret data or credential data.

title: Namespace identity checked before and after
statement: The image pull operation this component emits MUST check the namespace owner labels and observed UID before and after the Secret write.

title: Credential JSON shape
statement: The credential validator this component emits MUST accept only Docker `auths` JSON for exactly the selected one through eight registries, and MUST reject repeated JSON member names, credential helpers, wildcards, paths, and schemes.

title: Credential file read on every call
statement: The credential file operation this component emits MUST read the private file on every call, so a rotated operator credential reaches Kubernetes.

title: Whole assignment validated before a watch changes
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST validate the complete assignment before it changes any watch, and MUST keep the running watches when it refuses an assignment.

title: Changed identity stops the old watch first
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST stop and join the old watch before it starts the watch for a changed namespace identity.

title: Watch and aggregate object limits
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST stop when its aggregate object limit or byte limit is exceeded, MUST NOT start more watches than its observer's watch limit, and MUST refuse an object from another namespace.

title: One baseline at a time and no silent scope retry
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST keep at most one complete list in flight, and MUST NOT retry a failed scope before a new assignment supplies it.

title: Durable Secret state is never replaced
statement: The durable Secret state helper this component emits MUST NOT replace an existing Secret or its public digest marker, and MUST withhold the Secret until the namespace annotation and the external binding both equal its data digest.

title: Namespace identity rechecked before registration
statement: The durable Secret state helper this component emits MUST read the namespace identity again before it registers the digest with the application.

title: Reads continue while watches are open
statement: The client this component emits MUST permit an ordinary request while all of its configured watch streams are open.

title: No pinned admission renderer in the output
statement: The generated output this component emits MUST NOT contain the pinned admission policy renderer or its `PinnedAdmissionPolicies` function.

title: Consumer error stops the watch set
statement: The watch set this component emits MUST return the consumer's error, stop every watch, and then permit a new run.

title: No update of a terminating or absent resource
statement: The client this component emits MUST NOT patch or update a resource that is already being deleted, and MUST report an absent resource as an error.

title: Restricted container security
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST set runAsNonRoot, and each of its containers MUST use a read-only root filesystem, MUST refuse privilege escalation, and MUST drop all Linux capabilities.

title: RuntimeDefault seccomp profile
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST select the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile.

title: No automatic token mount
statement: The ServiceAccount and the Pod this component emits MUST disable automatic service-account token mounting.

title: HTTPS health probes
statement: Every HTTP probe in the service manifest this component emits MUST use the HTTPS scheme, and MUST NOT use a plaintext scheme.

title: Fixed probe routes
statement: The service container in the manifest this component emits MUST use /livez for its startup and liveness probes, and MUST use /readyz for its readiness probe.

title: Traffic is denied by default
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST declare both the Ingress and the Egress policy type for its workload Pods, so that traffic is denied unless a declared rule permits it.

title: DNS egress only to the declared resolver
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST permit UDP and TCP egress to the declared DNS namespace on the declared DNS port.

title: Narrow external egress rules
statement: Each external endpoint rule in the NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST contain exactly one host IP prefix and exactly one TCP port, and MUST NOT contain a CIDR range, a hostname, a zero port, a loopback, link-local, multicast, unspecified or IPv4-mapped address.

title: Endpoint bindings must be complete
statement: The renderer this component emits MUST refuse a render that omits a required external endpoint binding, names an undeclared binding, repeats a binding or crosses a workload scope, and MUST emit no manifest for it.

title: Ingress needs an enabled port
statement: The NetworkPolicy this component emits MUST NOT contain an ingress rule for a port that the selected workload does not expose.

title: Workers have no inbound path
statement: The worker manifest this component emits MUST NOT contain a Service, a container port or an ingress rule.

title: Workers never overlap
statement: The worker Deployment this component emits MUST use the Recreate strategy and MUST NOT set a replica count, so the platform overlay decides how many run and no two generations of one worker run at once.

title: RPC Service exposes one TLS port
statement: The RPC Service this component emits MUST expose exactly one port, 9090, and MUST NOT expose the loopback monitor address.

title: RPC rollout selection
statement: The RPC Deployment this component emits MUST NOT set a replica count, and MUST use RollingUpdate with one extra Pod and zero unavailable Pods unless the declaration selects Recreate.

title: Render inputs must be exact
statement: The renderer this component emits MUST refuse an image reference without an explicit registry and a lowercase SHA-256 digest, a namespace that is not a DNS label, and a zero file group, and MUST emit no output for them.

title: Scope split keeps every object
statement: Together, the cluster manifest and the namespace manifest this component emits MUST contain the same objects as the full manifest, each MUST contain only resources of its own scope, and an unknown resource kind or a wrong namespace MUST stop the render.

title: Configuration digest changes one annotation
statement: When a caller supplies a configuration digest, the manifest this component emits MUST change only the Pod template annotation stego.dev/config-sha256, and the renderer MUST refuse a value that is not a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 digest.

title: Owner labels cannot replace generated labels
statement: The resources this component emits MUST keep every generated label, and the renderer MUST refuse an owner label that conflicts with a generated label or that uses a reserved key prefix.

title: Image pull Secrets are references only
statement: The Pod this component emits MUST reference image pull Secrets by name in the selected workload's Pod template only, and MUST NOT contain a credential value.

title: Admission policies fail closed
statement: Each ValidatingAdmissionPolicy in the manifest this component emits MUST set failurePolicy Fail, and each matching ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding MUST use the Deny validation action.

title: The allocator cannot change its own controls
